reviews.title: Totally Disappointed!!!
reviews.text:
I’ve used LiveScore for years to follow everything from the prem to la liga, bundesliga, serie a, international football, wsl games, transfer news, literally everything. It’s been my go to app for a long time.
So I was really disappointed today when I opened it just to check fixtures and got blocked with a choice to either accept tracking cookies or pay £9.99 a month.
£9.99 for privacy? That feels excessive for a football scores app. I don’t think choosing not to be tracked should come at a subscription cost!!!!
Especially when the app already runs constant betting ads surely the money the get from that is enough to keep basic privacy choices free.
It’s a shame because I’ve relied on this app for years. But I’ve deleted it and had to look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Ruined by pop up ads

Will have to delete the app if it’s not fixed in the next update. I have a feeling they’re going to lose a lot of users.

The app is now unusable due to massively intrusive ads. It has been my first app for checking scores but won’t be going forward.
You wouldn’t mind the small ads as they were just a bit annoying but didn’t prevent you from using the app but now with these full screen inescapable ones and the ones that pop up at random times - it defeats the purpose of quickly checking a scoreline.
I see similar reviews appear over the last week, it won’t be long before the entire user base abandons this app for a better one. What a mistake!

 It was perfect before this and I was a loyal, everyday user of the app.. such a shame that the had to do this, won’t be touching the app again.. a very sad end to a once brilliant app 😢

⚠️⚠️⚠️

Terrible way to treat your longstanding customers.. such a shame.

reviews.title: Now you must pay £10 or accept 686 partner cookies…
reviews.text: I have been using this app since almost the very beginning and it’s been fantastic but today I was confronted with a splash screen asking me to pay £9.99 or plant 686 tracking cookies on my device to access the scores to free. There is a million other ways they could’ve done this to increase income but instead they took the easy and thoughtless mainstream media route of cookies for content. This is a complete travesty I can’t use the app ever again because of it. Installing this many cookies will have a devastating impact on unwitting users and their devices for the foreseeable which will be far more costly than the £10 that’s for sure. Such a shame but all good things must come to an end I guess.

reviews.title: Don’t fix what ain’t broke
reviews.text:
Probably the best scores app, however each update makes it less and less usable. Its key USP was simplicity and ease of use. Unfortunately now each time it gets an update it gets more cluttered and less user friendly. LiveScore - please stick with your roots rather than losing your USP.

Edit again - it’s broken again. First live tables weren’t updating and now it won’t load at all. Don’t mess with what was the best scores app! Now looking at alternatives.
